findings.title: Interpolating first bypasses the `$__range` splitting guard
findings.body: `querySupportsSplitting` relies on `isQueryWithRangeVariable(query.expr)` to keep queries containing `$__range` unsplit, because that variable must be evaluated against the original time range. Applying template variables here can replace `$__range` with a concrete value before the guard runs, so the query is then split into smaller ranges and executed with a value derived from the full range. This can change query results; preserve the original expression for this check or otherwise retain the range-variable marker.
